Name: Delaiah, of Tel-Melah
Summary: Named among those who returned from Tel-Melah but could not prove their genealogy (Ezra 2:60; Nehemiah 7:62). Not Delaiah son of Mehetabeel, who tried to trap Nehemiah.
LifeLesson: Two men, one name, two very different stories.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
